modinfo.title: CD Food Cooldown 2s (build 2026-09-23)
modinfo.author: Rogue69
modinfo.description: Sets all food shared cooldown to 2 seconds (2000ms). Covers 477 items. Vanilla cooldown is 1s (1000ms). Offsets re-derived against the 2026-09-23 game build (0.paver 020003000200e3cc19cb); each change also carries entry + rel_offset so DMM can re-anchor it after future patches.
